mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (indicating a restrictive monetary policy stance) increases the discount rate for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0%, it signals labor market weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in the consumer-driven demand sector, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change exceeding 5.0%), the Federal Reserve typically initiates monetary tightening, which increases discount rates for equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (indicating strong manufacturing and industrial output) signals expanding corporate earnings, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,600,000 units, it signals a cooling housing market and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1600.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and year-over-year inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO above 105.0), supply chain resilience and healthy corporate margins support positive equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
